summary: Price gate borderline: June 2027 Basic $50 Tue/$52 Sat, Standard $54/$56. Fees 48-58 -> 48-62; sites 700 -> 314; added 50A/W/S, season Apr 1-Oct 31, pull-through to 85 ft, weekend minimum. Waterfront lead.
flags: PRICE GATE, DROP CANDIDATE on most nights, for AWH: in the June 2027 season the only site at or under $50 is Basic on a weeknight ($50); Basic is $52 on a Saturday; Standard is $54 weeknight, $56 Saturday; Premium $60-62. Basic is only 6 sites (5 listed), described as 'smallest and least-desirable... pop ups or very small campers', though rated 26-32 ft so 23 ft fits. Plus $5 booking fee per stay. No gateway within 40 km. It clears the line only on Basic midweek. Google 4.4 (1,192) if a tiebreaker is wanted. RV Life $$$. The $48 is only a fall 2026 figure.
LONG-STAY: no issue. FAQ: 'does not have seasonal campsites'. Campspot sells one night on Basic and Standard midweek.
PRESENCE passes: own site, phone 419-994-2267, Campspot.

WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (up): stored 'not waterfront', but Campspot tags 4 Premium Pull-Through sites (301-304) 'Lake Front' and the FAQ says 'RV sites along the creek and surrounding our lake'.
